subject: Medidata CAIQ assertion closure & instrumentation proofset
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medidata.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medidata.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ follow-up: remaining assertions + runtime telemetry proofset

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Our security team finished their initial scan and we have a short list of remaining CAIQ assertions where they need either an owner attestation or runtime telemetry evidence (examples: key usage audit, KV-cache isolation traces, request-level tenant tagging). Can you share: 

- A short plan for closing the outstanding assertions (who owns which control)
- Representative runtime telemetry snippets showing tokenization / request-id tracebacks for a week window
- Any automated evidence extraction scripts if available (we prefer a reproducible extraction over manual screenshots)

We'd like to aim for closure by end of next week if feasible. I attached the Medidata CAIQ snapshot with highlighted rows.

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Park
Senior Security Engineer, Medidata
attachments: medidata_caiq_highlighted.xlsx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medidata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: remaining assertions + runtime telemetry proofset

Hi Elaine,

Appreciate the clear list — we'll take ownership. High level plan below; detailed mapping & artifacts to follow in a separate package.

Plan (owners & rough ETA):
- Assertion mapping + owner assignment (today): Jonas / Priyom
- Telemetry extraction & sample (72h): Priyom / Grace
- Artifact packaging & verification (48h after sample): Kimberly / Marissa
- Final attestation & control notes (end of next week): Jonas

I'll attach a working CAIQ assertions spreadsheet (v2) with owners and the initial artifact types we expect to provide. If Medidata prefers a narrower scope window for telemetry (e.g., 7 days vs 30 days), call that out and we'll adjust.

I'll start the extraction this afternoon and share the sample log + a short extraction script.

--
Jonas Weber
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
attachments: caiq_assertions_v2.xlsx
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: remaining assertions + runtime telemetry proofset

Adding details from the runtime side. Quick notes on what we'll produce for the telemetry proofset: 

- Request trace bundle (JSONL, redacted PII): request-id, model-id, route, tenant-hash, timestamp, duration_ms, token-count. Sample covers a 72-hour window by default.
- KV-cache isolation proof: side-by-side traces showing different tenant prefixes and KV cache hit/miss counters.
- Key usage and rotation metadata: KMS request log snippet showing envelope key IDs and rotation events (redacted key ids).
- Extraction script: small Python utility that pulls from our telemetry export API with filters and produces the sample bundle.

I'll drop the initial sample (telemetry_sample_20261019.log) and the extraction script to the shared Drive link Jonas posted. If Medidata needs signed attestations per-control, we'll prepare a one-page attestation per high-risk control.

- Priyom

attachments: telemetry_sample_20261019.log, extraction-script.py
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medidata.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: remaining assertions + runtime telemetry proofset

Elaine — looping in Ops/Support for any environment-specific questions while we gather artifacts. Two ops items to call out: 

1) If you want JVM-level traces for a particular hostpool we need a target timeframe (we cannot retroactively enable full debug traces without coordination).
2) For tenant-tagging validation we can provide request headers and our route table; please confirm whether header-level hashes are acceptable or you need full header values redacted.

We will provide an internal runbook describing how artifacts were extracted so your auditors can reproduce the sample. ETA remains end of next week for the complete package.

-Marissa

attachments: infra-instrumentation-matrix.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medidata.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: remaining assertions + runtime telemetry proofset

Hi Elaine,

Attached is the artifact index for the controls we discussed. Short clarifications: 
- Retention window: default telemetry export covers 30 days; our sample will be 72 hours but we can extend if you need longer retention evidence.
- Redaction: all samples are PII-redacted and we will provide column-level documentation for every field.
- Ownership: the spreadsheet Jonas shared marks each CAIQ item to the owning team and the primary artifact type (log, attestation, runbook, screenshot).

Next steps: once you confirm the retention window and whether header hashes are allowed, we'll finalize the sample bundle and push the Drive folder with signed attestations.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Trust Program Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: artifact-index-control-owners.csv
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medidata.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medidata.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: remaining assertions + runtime telemetry proofset

Thanks — this looks good. Two quick clarifications before we validate: 

1) Retention window: please include 7 full days for the telemetry bundle (UTC-aligned).
2) Header values: header-level hashes are fine for tenant identifiers, but we need at least one example that shows a full, redacted header set to verify mapping.

Once those are in the Drive link and we have the one-page signed attestations, we'll close the remaining CAIQ rows and schedule a short verification call. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elaine
